API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIAppProtection Control ManagementGet the predefined control for the specified ID.
Get the predefined control for the specified ID.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/inspectionControls/predefined/:id

Get the predefined control for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

id
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the AppProtection control.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
405
409
415
500
503

OK

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
action
string

The action of the predefined control.

Possible values: [PASS, BLOCK, REDIRECT, ALLOW]

actionValue
string

The value for the predefined controls action. This field is only required if the action is set to REDIRECT.

associatedInspectionProfileNames
NameIdDto[]
attachment
string

The control attachment.

controlException
InspectionControlExceptions
controlGroup
string

The control group.

controlNumber
int32

The control number of the predefined control.

controlType
string

The control type of the custom control.

Possible values: [WEBSOCKET_PREDEFINED, WEBSOCKET_CUSTOM, THREATLABZ, CUSTOM, PREDEFINED, API_PREDEFINED, ADP_PREDEFINED]

creationTime
int32

The time the custom control is created.

defaultAction
string

The performed action.

Possible values: [PASS, BLOCK, REDIRECT, ALLOW]

defaultActionValue
string

Used to provide the redirect URL if the default action is set to REDIRECT.

description
string

The description of the predefined control.

id
int64

The unique identifier of the predefined control.

modifiedBy
int64

The unique identifier of the tenant who modified the predefined control.

modifiedTime
int32

The time the predefined control is modified.

name
string
REQUIRED

The name of the application.

paranoiaLevel
int32

The OWASP Predefined Paranoia Level. To learn more, see Configuring AppProtection Profiles.

protocolType
string

The protocol type of the predefined control.

Possible values: [HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, RDP, SSH, WEBSOCKET, VNC, REALVNC, NONE, AUTO, DYNAMIC, KRB, LDAP, SMB]

severity
string

The severity of the AppProtection control number. To learn more, see About AppProtection Controls.

Possible values: [CRITICAL, ERROR, WARNING, INFO]

version
string

The predefined control version.
